findings.description: realtime.rs applies RFC1982 ordering through one global last_server_sequence instead of per-remote-handle sequences. Valid independent lifecycle streams therefore conflict: a second remote SPAWN with sequence 1, or a new remote whose sequence is lower than another remote's latest sequence, is rejected as ProtocolViolation. This breaks the required multi-remote capacity and valid server lifecycle semantics.

run_realtime schedules grant expiry as a terminal branch after the WebSocket is authenticated and Ready, returning Expired and closing the active session at the 30-second ticket deadline. The grant is a one-use upgrade capability; the authoritative scope bounds redemption/upgrade, not the lifetime of an authenticated session.
